originality.rationale: Best-knowledge full claim is unlocated: existing Kosuda minimum-admissibility criterion and counts are explicitly credited and excluded from novelty, while the finite all-threshold monoid-power walk formula and Brownian limit are not stated or directly implied by the inspected minimum-only theorem. Speyer gives longest subword existence, not full counts. Structural broader sorting-network equivalences are residual risk.
residual_risks: A more general heap/periodic comparator theorem may imply the threshold formula; not every historical source was accessible or exhaustively read.
Kosuda explicitly gives already-known minimum-level counts; these are not original contributions here.
Earlier inaccessible records cannot establish absence of prior results.
Brownian exit distribution is standard; novelty claimed only for its occurrence as the Coxeter stabilization-time law.

value.rationale: The least absorbing power of a Coxeter element is an intrinsic, natural dynamic invariant. An all-orientation exact maximum formula, complete finite transfer census and nondegenerate Brownian supremum limit bridge algebraic shortest powers to random-walk fluctuations, quantitatively distinguishing typical from extremal Coxeter sorting schedules.
